Sports.title: Rory McIlroy snubbed by Amanda Balionis before the Masters as she makes thoughts clear
Sports.content:
Rory McIlroy snubbed by Amanda Balionis before the Masters as she makes thoughts clear

Masters champion Rory McIlroy and world number one Scottie Scheffler do not make the cut for Amanda Balionis, who has a dozen picks for this year's tournament at Augusta National

View 2 Images Rory McIlroy is not top of Amanda Balionis' list of Masters picks (Image: Getty Images)

Amanda Balionis does not include either Rory McIlroy or Scottie Scheffler in the dozen or so picks she has for the Masters. Adam Scott, Bryson DeChambeau and Justin Rose are among those she believes could win it instead of the world's top two players.

‌



Balionis, 39, will be back at Augusta National this year with CBS, 12 months after witnessing McIlroy make history. However, she is not talking up his chances of becoming just the fourth back-to-back champion.

‌



Scheffler is also someone she is not including. That is despite the world number one winning two of the last four Masters tournaments. Speaking on the Fairway Rollin' Podcast, Balionis said: "I have 12 or 13 names, and that doesn't include Scottie or Rory." She added: "I don't think you can just count Bryson (DeChambeau) out.

‌



"I just think Bryson has such a chip on his shoulder. I think about this moment a lot from last year, when he came into the interview room after he thought he'd pretty much given it away, and he had that disaster on 11."

DeChambeau double-bogeyed the 11th hole to leave McIlroy with a four-shot lead. The American led after birdying the second before back-to-back bogeys on three and four.
